review.inspection: Archive entries, .prj, and embedded .shp.xml were examined. No source geometry is included in this evidence packet.
review.applicability_limit: This is district-level polyline data, not county-level polygon geometry. It cannot determine the original 112 Irumu residual keys' county containment, validate the UBOS county archive projection, or determine territorial applicability.
review.effect: Adds contemporaneous UBOS/WRI source context only; no repair, disposition, hold, owner, credit, or denominator changes.

overlay_result.method_limit: The line/side check uses only the nearest directed segment and its numeric adjacency fields; it does not reconstruct polygons or identify FID 61 by name. See the linked evidence file for full method and limits.
overlay_result.fid_identity_assessment: No direct WRI FID-to-name table is present in the shipped archive. For these 112 centers, all 62 on the RIGHT_FID=61 side fall in UBOS 2006 counties whose DNAME_2006 is BUNDIBUGYO; all 50 on the LEFT_FID=-1 side fall outside the 164 UBOS counties. This supports identifying FID 61 as Bundibugyo for this local overlap, but is not a direct attribute crosswalk or legal boundary determination.
